Amazing Experience!

I had such a great experience with Tiny Tails! They did an amazing job, and my dog looked absolutely adorable and so well-groomed when I picked him up. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs and take pride in their work. I’m so happy with how everything turned out and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

Hands down, Tiny Tails is one of the best grooming services my dogs, Oreo and Bruno have ever received! My boys always come home looking adorable and smelling amazing.

As a first-time dog owner, I’m always a little nervous leaving them anywhere but the staff at Tiny Tails always puts my mind at ease. They send me updates and pictures during every visit, which means so much to me and shows how much they genuinely care about the dogs they groom.

The entire team is professional, friendly, and welcoming. They take the time to get to know each dog’s personality and needs. Oreo, my black Chihuahua mix can be a little sassy, but they handle him with so much patience and care. Bruno, my Yorkie-Poodle mix gets plenty of love, attention, and his favorite belly rubs every visit.

It’s clear that everyone at Tiny Tails truly loves what they do, and it shows in the way they treat every pet. I highly recommend Tiny Tails to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and professional groomer. My boys are always excited to go back, and I wouldn’t trust them with anyone else!
My dog gets nervous but they do an amazing job. He smells amazing and his cut is always excatly how I want it.

Our nervous pup had a very difficult first groom at another business. Brought her to Tiny Tails and Deirdre did an amazing job! Night and day experiences. The entire staff was so kind and our puppy left so happy. Thank you Tiny Tails!
Such amazing service and care....Highly recommend trusting your pet with this crew. Thank you so much 💓
Annie is an amazing groomer. She treats my Bella with affection and kindness. Lori is a sweetheart.
Very friendly shop, with professional service.
Best place for my dog

Batman looks PAWfect! I took my Shih Tzu Batman here at Tiny Tails, and I’m beyond impressed! The team was so gentle, professional, and truly passionate about what they do.
When I picked him up, he looked absolutely adorable—his haircut was neat and stylish, his coat was soft and shiny, and he smelled so fresh! They even added a cute little touch that made him look extra special with a bandana.

Thank you, Tiny Tails, for making Batman’s grooming such a great experience. We’ll definitely be back & booked future appointments too! Highly recommend to any pet parent who wants top-notch, loving care for their furry friend!
Can’t recommend Tiny Tails enough, my toy poodle Luka comes home looking like a show dog every time. The attention to detail and care provided are unmatched!!
Our dog actually loves to come here. It's like a play date for him. And he always comes out looking amazing.

It was my pups first time getting groomed here and I must say he is so soft & smells so good I’m extremely happy. I was a little nervous at first cause he has back & leg  problems so I did let them know to be very careful, at other groomers when I would get him back he would have a episode cause his problems would act up. When we picked him up he was so hyper and active and not having any pain so I’m so pleased! I also love that he got to meet new pup friends and just by seeing his personality I know he had a great time! Thank you so Much for taking care of my baby
